title: Memory as Code: Declarative Retrieval over Codified Long-Term Memory
abstract: arXiv:2610.27700v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In long-term memory systems, memories are constructed from interaction histories and retrieved in response to queries, enhancing the reasoning ability of LLM agents. In complex scenarios, facts are scattered across sessions and their relationships evolve over time, making it difficult for existing memory systems to compose them to adapt to diverse queries. Motivated by the modularity and composability of code, we propose Memory as Code (MaC), a unified memory framework that jointly designs memory construction and retrieval through a shared code abstraction. MaC couples codified construction, which establishes executable memory abstractions, with declarative retrieval, which translates queries into structured retrieval programs. Specifically, codified construction builds a three-layer executable memory structure that progresses from an atomic function layer, through a relational layer, to a modular composition layer. Declarative retrieval

translated_title: 记忆即代码：基于编码化长期记忆的声明式检索
translated_abstract: 在长期记忆系统中，记忆从交互历史中构建，并根据查询进行检索，从而增强大语言模型智能体的推理能力。在复杂场景中，事实分散在各个会话之中，且它们之间的关系随时间不断演变，这使得现有记忆系统难以组合这些事实以适应多样化的查询。受代码的模块化与可组合性的启发，我们提出了Memory as Code (MaC)，这是一个统一的记忆框架，通过共享的代码抽象来联合设计记忆构建与检索。MaC将编码化构建（建立可执行的记忆抽象）与声明式检索（将查询转化为结构化的检索程序）相结合。具体而言，编码化构建了一个三层可执行记忆结构，从原子函数层出发，经过关系层，再到模块化组合层逐层递进。声明式检索……
tldr: 提出Memory as Code (MaC)框架，以共享代码抽象统一设计记忆构建与声明式检索，通过原子函数层、关系层、模块化组合层的三层可执行记忆结构，解决长期记忆中事实分散、关系动态演变导致难以组合检索的问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes Memory as Code (MaC), a unified memory framework that jointly designs codified memory construction and declarative retrieval through a shared code abstraction, leveraging a three-layer executable memory structure (atomic function, relational, and modular composition layers) to address scattered facts and evolving relationships in long-term memory.
